svg.title: What you type is what you keep
svg.desc: You type 00501 (ZIP code): Excel shows 501 (leading zeros dropped); Sheets keeps 00501. You type 4111111111111111 (16-digit card number): Excel shows 4.11111E+15 (stored as …1110: last digit lost); Sheets keeps 4111111111111111. You type SEPT1 (gene name): Excel shows 1-Sep (turned into a date); Sheets keeps SEPT1. You type café (in a UTF-8 CSV file): Excel shows cafÃ© (read with the wrong encoding); Sheets keeps café.
